title: Glowing Joe's Ores
description: Makes them glow, it's all you need to know, So give it a go!
body:
THE ORES WONT GLOW WITHOUT HAVING ONE OF THESE THINGS INSTALLED:

Optifine (Forge) or Continuity (Fabric) and connector-2.0.0-beta.10+1.21.1-full
The Resource pack heavily relies on the Emissive properties used by Optifine/Continuity Client/Mod.
